# Output Format Reference Template

```markdown
---
title: <deliverable title>
status: draft | approved
sources: []
---

# <Deliverable title>

## Executive summary
## Evidence and constraints
## Recommended action or deliverable
## Open questions
```

Use this reference when a skill needs a consistent Markdown output. Put workflow-specific
sections below the common header and retain `[Missing]` or `[Needs approval]` markers.
